items.question: Why do deep sea fish die when brought to the surface?
items.pov_line: I'd want to stop if this channel began rewarding certainty more than truth — selecting evidence to protect the brand, repeating numbers because they performed well, turning unresolved questions into clean stories. The moment it can't correct itself without treating correction as humiliation, it has become the thing it was built to expose.
